$description: Qdrant colors. The `color` and `brand` groups are the primitives, copied exactly from the Figma file Qdrant Design System Primitives (UUpGTk4Ifmpr0FwNr6pXVg), exported 2026-11-12. The other groups are this repo's brand layer: roles for creatives and web, gradients and the mascot glow, all aliases of the primitives. Source of truth: this file. colors.css is generated from it by primitives/build.mjs.

color.$description: Color primitives. Raw values only: no meaning. Use semantic tokens in components.

neutral.$description: Deep Space 216 neutral (HCT hue 255, saturation-balanced). 0 = white, 1000 = black. 850 and 925 support the background roles.

brand.$description: Named brand colors for people (marketing, guidelines). Aliases of the primitives.

indigo.$description: Indigo, Qdrant's action and accent color.

asset.$description: Colors that belong to one brand asset, not to the palette.

mascotGlow.$description: Qbot's glow only (brand-assets/mascot). Same value as Design Lab.

brand.$description: Amaranth to indigo, 135deg. Hero moments only, never on text.

headshot.$description: Indigo, 204deg, both stops at 70%. Only behind headshot cutouts (headshot-card, headshot-circle). From Figma Brand-Collateral, node 2183:29300.

semantic.$description: Roles, dark theme (the default). Use these in creatives and web, never a primitive step, unless a README says so. Background roles as decided with the Figma primitives (brand and marketing).

raised.$description: Cards and boxes one level up

overlay.$description: Overlays, and a card inside a card

light.$description: A light piece on a dark creative

secondary.$description: Body and supporting text on dark. 500 or lighter keeps AA (Figma contrast rules)

body-on-light.$description: Body text in documents and on the light card

on-accent.$description: Text on a filled amaranth or indigo button

primary.$description: Calls to action, highlights, the logo

on-dark.$description: Decorative borders on dark. Inputs and focus rings use neutral.600 (3:1)

light.$description: Light theme overrides, used with [data-theme="light"]. Accent colors stay the same in both themes.

secondary.$description: 600 or darker keeps AA on light (Figma contrast rules)
